title: Global dynamics and asymptotic stability for a nonlocal LANS-$α$-type system
summary: This paper is devoted to the global dynamics of a nonlocal Lagrangian-averaged Navier-Stokes-$α$ (LANS-$α$)-type system (also known as the viscous Euler-Poincaré system) in one, two, and three spatial dimensions. In the unforced periodic setting with zero mean, we establish global well-posedness for the initial-value problem and prove that the corresponding solution semigroup is dissipative and possesses a compact global attractor consisting of the singleton $\{0\}$.
